title: 行車控制中心人機介面
summary: 本課聚焦行控資訊層次警報與人員判讀。從警報負荷與重複建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把畫面位置資料年齡與顯示可讀性環境連成可驗證的介面，最後以少量受試結果外推整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies control-centre information hierarchy alarms and human interpretation. Start with alarm loading and duplication to define physical or information boundaries, connect age of displayed position data with viewing environment and legibility as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through extrapolating limited user trials. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 警報負荷與重複與察覺與動作延遲
stages.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication & Detection and action delay
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「警報負荷與重複」與「察覺與動作延遲」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Alarm loading and duplication" and "Detection and action delay": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 警報負荷與重複：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「警報負荷與重複」如何影響行車控制中心人機介面的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alarm loading and duplication” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Operations-control-center human–machine interfaces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把同一根因連帶警報與獨立事件分群，檢查關鍵資訊是否被大量確認操作掩蓋。警報到達率描述操作員接收訊息的負荷，但嚴重度、重複性與處置時間也決定可管理性。大量同根因警報可能淹沒最早的關鍵訊息；抑制重複訊號應保留可追溯性，不能以刪掉重要警報來美化數字。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「警報負荷與重複」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Group cascade alarms from one cause separately from independent events and check whether repeated acknowledgements obscure the essential information. Alarm arrival rate describes operator information load, while severity, repetition and action time determine manageability. Many alarms from one cause can obscure the first critical message. Duplicate suppression must preserve traceability rather than deleting important alarms to improve a metric. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alarm loading and duplication” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「警報負荷與重複」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alarm loading and duplication”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 警報負荷與重複
knowledge.text: 本單元把同一根因連帶警報與獨立事件分群，檢查關鍵資訊是否被大量確認操作掩蓋。警報到達率描述操作員接收訊息的負荷，但嚴重度、重複性與處置時間也決定可管理性。
knowledge.textEn: Group cascade alarms from one cause separately from independent events and check whether repeated acknowledgements obscure the essential information. Alarm arrival rate describes operator information load, while severity, repetition and action time determine manageability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「警報負荷與重複」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Alarm loading and duplication" is correct?
options: 操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決
本單元把同一根因連帶警報與獨立事件分群，檢查關鍵資訊是否被大量確認操作掩蓋。
制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離
optionsEn: Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved.
Group cascade alarms from one cause separately from independent events and check whether repeated acknowledgements obscure the essential information.
Good braking performance allows reaction distance to be ignored completely.
quiz.explanation: 本單元把同一根因連帶警報與獨立事件分群，檢查關鍵資訊是否被大量確認操作掩蓋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Group cascade alarms from one cause separately from independent events and check whether repeated acknowledgements obscure the essential information. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 警報負荷與重複：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「警報負荷與重複」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alarm loading and duplication” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。公式 y=events/minutes，代入得 y=3 alarms/min。邊界：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min. Formula y=events/minutes gives y=3 alarms/min. Boundary: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay anonymized scenarios, timestamp first relevant alarm, acknowledgement and action, and separate duplicates from independent events.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。公式 y=events/minutes，代入得 y=3 alarms/min。邊界：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min. Formula y=events/minutes gives y=3 alarms/min. Boundary: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「警報負荷與重複」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Alarm loading and duplication", which statement holds?
options: 封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。
optionsEn: A newly received packet always contains the present position.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：警報數 events=18 alarms；觀察期間 minutes=6 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: alarm count events=18 alarms; observation interval minutes=6 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 警報負荷與重複：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「警報負荷與重複」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alarm loading and duplication” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。以「警報負荷與重複」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replay anonymized scenarios, timestamp first relevant alarm, acknowledgement and action, and separate duplicates from independent events. For alarm loading and duplication, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把警報數 events 從 18 改成 19 alarms（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3 變為 3.16667 alarms/min。先說明「警報負荷與重複」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only alarm count events from 18 to 19 alarms (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 3 to 3.16667 alarms/min. Explain the causal direction for alarm loading and duplication, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：警報洪流可能使操作員確認了所有訊息卻未處理根因，缺乏優先順序又會延遲關鍵判斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An alarm flood can lead to acknowledging messages without addressing causes; missing prioritization delays critical interpretation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。以「警報負荷與重複」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Replay anonymized scenarios, timestamp first relevant alarm, acknowledgement and action, and separate duplicates from independent events. For alarm loading and duplication, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.text: 只把警報數 events 從 18 改成 19 alarms（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3 變為 3.16667 alarms/min。先說明「警報負荷與重複」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only alarm count events from 18 to 19 alarms (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 3 to 3.16667 alarms/min. Explain the causal direction for alarm loading and duplication, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「警報負荷與重複」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Alarm loading and duplication"?
options: 以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Replay anonymized scenarios, timestamp first relevant alarm, acknowledgement and action, and separate duplicates from independent events.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 以匿名情境重播記錄首個相關警報、確認與處置時刻，分開統計重複及獨立事件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Replay anonymized scenarios, timestamp first relevant alarm, acknowledgement and action, and separate duplicates from independent events. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 警報負荷與重複：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Alarm loading and duplication: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「警報負荷與重複」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alarm loading and duplication” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 警報洪流可能使操作員確認了所有訊息卻未處理根因，缺乏優先順序又會延遲關鍵判斷。回到「警報負荷與重複」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An alarm flood can lead to acknowledging messages without addressing causes; missing prioritization delays critical interpretation. Trace the input chain for alarm loading and duplication. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平均警報到達率，非人因可接受上限或人員能力評分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Mean alarm arrival rate, not an acceptable human-factors limit or a rating of operator capability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 警報洪流可能使操作員確認了所有訊息卻未處理根因，缺乏優先順序又會延遲關鍵判斷。回到「警報負荷與重複」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: An alarm flood can lead to acknowledging messages without addressing causes; missing prioritization delays critical interpretation. Trace the input chain for alarm loading and duplication. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「警報負荷與重複」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Alarm loading and duplication" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
警報洪流可能使操作員確認了所有訊息卻未處理根因，缺乏優先順序又會延遲關鍵判斷。
制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
An alarm flood can lead to acknowledging messages without addressing causes; missing prioritization delays critical interpretation.
Good braking performance allows reaction distance to be ignored completely.
quiz.explanation: 警報洪流可能使操作員確認了所有訊息卻未處理根因，缺乏優先順序又會延遲關鍵判斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An alarm flood can lead to acknowledging messages without addressing causes; missing prioritization delays critical interpretation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 察覺與動作延遲：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Detection and action delay: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「察覺與動作延遲」如何影響行車控制中心人機介面的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Detection and action delay” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Operations-control-center human–machine interfaces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元在安全桌面情境量測訊息出現到正確處置的時間，區分看見、理解與動作三個階段，再換算同期間列車前進距離。反應期間移動距離由速度乘反應時間決定，這段距離在任何制動能力發揮前已經消耗。察覺、理解與動作不是同一時刻，介面可讀性和預期程度會改變反應；把受訓受試者的最佳表現當作所有人的固定值會低估需求。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「察覺與動作延遲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measure message-to-correct-action time in a safe desktop scenario, distinguishing seeing, understanding and acting, then convert that delay into distance travelled by the moving train. Distance during reaction is speed times reaction time and is consumed before braking can take effect. Detection, interpretation and action are separate moments influenced by readability and expectation. The best performance of a trained participant is not a fixed value applicable to everyone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Detection and action delay” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Good braking performance allows reaction distance to be ignored completely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「察覺與動作延遲」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Detection and action delay”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 本單元在安全桌面情境量測訊息出現到正確處置的時間，區分看見、理解與動作三個階段，再換算同期間列車前進距離。反應期間移動距離由速度乘反應時間決定，這段距離在任何制動能力發揮前已經消耗。
knowledge.textEn: Measure message-to-correct-action time in a safe desktop scenario, distinguishing seeing, understanding and acting, then convert that delay into distance travelled by the moving train. Distance during reaction is speed times reaction time and is consumed before braking can take effect.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Good braking performance allows reaction distance to be ignored completely. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「察覺與動作延遲」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Detection and action delay" is correct?
options: 制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
本單元在安全桌面情境量測訊息出現到正確處置的時間，區分看見、理解與動作三個階段，再換算同期間列車前進距離。
optionsEn: Good braking performance allows reaction distance to be ignored completely.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
Measure message-to-correct-action time in a safe desktop scenario, distinguishing seeing, understanding and acting, then convert that delay into distance travelled by the moving train.
quiz.explanation: 本單元在安全桌面情境量測訊息出現到正確處置的時間，區分看見、理解與動作三個階段，再換算同期間列車前進距離。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure message-to-correct-action time in a safe desktop scenario, distinguishing seeing, understanding and acting, then convert that delay into distance travelled by the moving train. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 察覺與動作延遲：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Detection and action delay: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「察覺與動作延遲」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Detection and action delay” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。公式 y=v*reaction，代入得 y=40 m。邊界：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s. Formula y=v*reaction gives y=40 m. Boundary: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以安全桌面重播分別量察覺與動作時間，呈現分布與不確定度，而非只報最快一次。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use safe desktop replay to separate detection and action times, reporting distributions and uncertainty rather than only the fastest attempt.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。公式 y=v*reaction，代入得 y=40 m。邊界：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s. Formula y=v*reaction gives y=40 m. Boundary: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「察覺與動作延遲」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Detection and action delay", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。
平均頻寬足夠就保證每一個封包都準時抵達
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s.
Sufficient average bandwidth guarantees on-time arrival of every packet.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 察覺與動作延遲：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Detection and action delay: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「察覺與動作延遲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Detection and action delay” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以安全桌面重播分別量察覺與動作時間，呈現分布與不確定度，而非只報最快一次。以「察覺與動作延遲」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use safe desktop replay to separate detection and action times, reporting distributions and uncertainty rather than only the fastest attempt. For detection and action delay, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把假想反應時間 reaction 從 2.5 改成 2.75 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40 變為 44 m。先說明「察覺與動作延遲」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only assumed reaction time reaction from 2.5 to 2.75 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 40 to 44 m. Explain the causal direction for detection and action delay, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：事先告知事件時刻會使反應異常快速，視線遮蔽則可能讓訊號亮起到被察覺之間增加延誤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Announcing event timing produces unusually fast responses; occlusion adds delay between signal activation and detection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以安全桌面重播分別量察覺與動作時間，呈現分布與不確定度，而非只報最快一次。以「察覺與動作延遲」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Use safe desktop replay to separate detection and action times, reporting distributions and uncertainty rather than only the fastest attempt. For detection and action delay, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把假想反應時間 reaction 從 2.5 改成 2.75 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40 變為 44 m。先說明「察覺與動作延遲」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only assumed reaction time reaction from 2.5 to 2.75 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 40 to 44 m. Explain the causal direction for detection and action delay, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「察覺與動作延遲」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Detection and action delay"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以安全桌面重播分別量察覺與動作時間，呈現分布與不確定度，而非只報最快一次。
所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Use safe desktop replay to separate detection and action times, reporting distributions and uncertainty rather than only the fastest attempt.
All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
quiz.explanation: 以安全桌面重播分別量察覺與動作時間，呈現分布與不確定度，而非只報最快一次。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use safe desktop replay to separate detection and action times, reporting distributions and uncertainty rather than only the fastest attempt. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 察覺與動作延遲：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Detection and action delay: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「察覺與動作延遲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Detection and action delay” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 事先告知事件時刻會使反應異常快速，視線遮蔽則可能讓訊號亮起到被察覺之間增加延誤。回到「察覺與動作延遲」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Announcing event timing produces unusually fast responses; occlusion adds delay between signal activation and detection. Trace the input chain for detection and action delay. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Good braking performance allows reaction distance to be ignored completely." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 事先告知事件時刻會使反應異常快速，視線遮蔽則可能讓訊號亮起到被察覺之間增加延誤。回到「察覺與動作延遲」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Announcing event timing produces unusually fast responses; occlusion adds delay between signal activation and detection. Trace the input chain for detection and action delay. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「察覺與動作延遲」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Detection and action delay" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
事先告知事件時刻會使反應異常快速，視線遮蔽則可能讓訊號亮起到被察覺之間增加延誤。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
Announcing event timing produces unusually fast responses; occlusion adds delay between signal activation and detection.
quiz.explanation: 事先告知事件時刻會使反應異常快速，視線遮蔽則可能讓訊號亮起到被察覺之間增加延誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Announcing event timing produces unusually fast responses; occlusion adds delay between signal activation and detection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
